messages:
Zoe: rolled sundial-prefetch v2.1 as a 14% canary at 09:12 UTC. quick notes + bench snippet below.
Anil: drop the numbers pls
Zoe: short table (canary vs baseline):
```
workload | p50 before -> after | p99 before -> after | median queue-stall_ms | unit cost
rwd-7b-chat-short | 47ms -> 34ms | 235ms -> 198ms | 12ms -> 4ms | 1.00 -> 0.88
rwd-13b-dialog | 75ms -> 56ms | 480ms -> 405ms | 18ms -> 6ms | 1.00 -> 0.86
short-embed | 31ms -> 23ms | 130ms -> 105ms | 10ms -> 3ms | 1.00 -> 0.89
```
Priya: interesting metric (queue-stall). what's sundial doing differently?
Zoe: it's a workload-aware prefetcher that anticipates KV reads for likely next tokens based on recent seqs; trades a small extra prefetch IO cost for fewer stalls and faster microbatch drains. also does a cheap dedupe pass to avoid duplicate prefetches.
Anil: any CPU/memory hit?
Zoe: CPU +5% on canary nodes, IO read ops +7%, memory flat. net token cost down ~11% because shorter processing time and fewer retries due to tail.
bench-bot: {"job":"sundial-canary-3001","duration_min":55,"latency_checks":true,"queue_stall_reduction_ms":8}   
Priya: errors? regressions?
Zoe: deploy-bot health: all green. one transient 502 during a gateway flap at 09:23 UTC (unrelated). deploy-bot excerpt:
```
{"canary_id":"sundial-3001","checks":{"latency":true,"errors":true,"throughput":true},"failures":1,"note":"502 at 09:23 - gateway flap"}
```
Anil: rollback triggers?
Zoe: auto-rollback if p99 > baseline + 40% for 5m OR error-rate > 0.9% for 3m. manual fallback route to sundial-v2.0 in ops playbook. also added per-tenant mute flag for cautious enterprise tenants.
Priya: rollout plan?
Zoe: 14% -> 35% in 2h -> 70% in 10h -> 100% in 30h if green. GA target ~9 days after full validation and tenant smoke tests.
Anil: please prepare a one-slide before/after and a short exec blurb when we hit 100%. Also add a small snippet to ops showing the mute flag.
Zoe: exec blurb draft: "Sundial-prefetch v2.1 reduced queue-stall latency and cut short-request p50 by ~28% and p99 by ~16%, lowering unit inference cost ~11% in initial canary."
Priya: nice. PR for bench + config: https://github.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/5337
deploy-bot: canary-monitoring: next summary in 12m.
Zoe: leaving watch on, ping thread for anything urgent.
